title: just-deliver release manifest
description: What a team authors to cut a release: one label and the workload definitions that belong to it, with the order they must deploy in. `jd release create` turns it into an immutable release set. Ordering is a release concern, so dependsOn lives here and not in the workload definitions.

definition.description: Path of the workload definition, relative to this manifest.

dependsOn.description: Names (metadata.name) of workloads in this manifest that must be deployed first. Ordering only: it grants no access to their resources.
